scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k -n vite,tsc,electron "vite" "tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json -w --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 file:dist-electron/main.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build:electron
